procedural_landmarks.geometry_strategy: Build a new low-poly square shaft, clock stage, arcaded crown, and pyramidal spire from UC archival drawings and openly licensed reference photographs.
procedural_landmarks.reason_no_donor: The only exact Sketchfab candidate is unlicensed, non-downloadable, texture-dependent, and 810317 faces. The very small 3D Warehouse model lacks a redistributable open license.

procedural_landmarks.geometry_strategy: Build a new rounded-square, vertically straight lower mass that tapers above level 27 into a translucent-looking open crown expressed with a few pale flat materials.
procedural_landmarks.reason_no_donor: No open, downloadable building donor with clean provenance was found. The City building-mass dataset derives from 2010 imagery and predates this 2018 tower.

procedural_landmarks.landmark: Mount Diablo Summit Building and aviation beacon

placement.source: USGS GNIS summit coordinate as reproduced by the USGS-derived TopoQuest record

procedural_landmarks.elevation_source: California State Parks gives 3849 ft; runtime placement must still drape the building to the acquired terrain surface.
procedural_landmarks.geometry_strategy: Build a new small sandstone summit building, rotunda, observation deck, and beacon from California State Parks documentation; terrain recognition matters more than building detail until close range.
procedural_landmarks.reason_no_donor: No reusable open 3D donor or published measured plan was found in this pass.

procedural_landmarks.landmark: Treasure Island / Yerba Buena Island historic group
procedural_landmarks.geometry_strategy: Treat the current Bay Bridge and Yerba Buena tunnel portals as the first landmark. If island architecture is later needed, derive simplified massing from government HABS records for Treasure Island Buildings 1, 2, 3/111 rather than imagery-derived city models.
procedural_landmarks.reason_no_donor: No suitable open 3D donor was found; HABS supplies reference documentation rather than a ready mesh.

procedural_landmarks.landmark: San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge, current east span
procedural_landmarks.geometry_strategy: Create a new low-poly self-anchored suspension tower/cable silhouette plus repeatable skyway segments from MTC/Caltrans dimensions and public engineering documentation.
procedural_landmarks.reason_no_donor: FlightGear model 77 represents the original east span and predates the current span's September 2013 opening.

rejected_sources.name: FlightGear San Francisco East Bay Bridge, model 77

rejected_sources.name: 3D Warehouse Model of the Sather Tower
rejected_sources.reason: Attractive 305-polygon donor, but 3D Warehouse's General Model License is not an open redistribution license for a stand-alone mesh derivative. Do not vendor without explicit author permission.
